description: Organize a bounded Minecraft UGC design review and synthesize a version for independent specialist review.
use_cases: Meeting opening, issue summaries and proposal revisions.

deployment_geography.cloud_data: Local review material may be included in the cloud planner's later context.

requirements.credentials: Gateway-managed provider authentication; never supplied in meeting context.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: A host can claim consensus or close another specialist's issue without evidence.
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Python enforces same-version approval, owner-only issue closure and the three-to-four-round limit.

ethical_considerations: No art integration or asset generation.
Do not claim model opinions are game test results.
Use only meeting material permitted for the configured cloud data boundary.
